create_feature_match_loss: create a FeatureMatchLoss module to compute L1-based feature matching loss between generator and ground truth discriminator features
use_feature_match_loss_forward: use the forward method to calculate feature matching loss from generator and ground truth discriminator output lists
configure_average_by_layers: configure FeatureMatchLoss to average the loss across discriminator layers by setting average_by_layers to True
configure_average_by_discriminators: configure FeatureMatchLoss to average the loss across multiple discriminators by setting average_by_discriminators to True
configure_include_final_outputs: configure FeatureMatchLoss to include final discriminator outputs in the loss calculation by setting include_final_outputs to True
